description: No clean concept found. Strongest correlate: the opponent's last stone set up an opponent win cell directly on top of it (a must-block in the column just played), and the top activations are mostly lost positions where the opponent has several low horizontal/diagonal threats. Plain vertical threes and open double threats by themselves do not fire; near threshold it fires on assorted local stone patterns with no threat.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to max changes move probabilities by at most 0.03.
notes: 4 dev calls. H1 (win cell above opponent's last stone) F1 0.171 AUROC 0.65; non-vertical must-block F1 0.139; unstoppable threat F1 0.097; dead flanked O runs F1 0.080. Minimal pairs show very position-specific triggers (e.g. O at a1,b1 + X at c1,d2 fires; shifted by one column does not). Clean vertical threes and open horizontal threes are negative. Likely a mixture or random direction.
